newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Pacific Can places out 3.55 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Can places out 3.55 mln shares.

text.p: Pacific Can Investment Holdings Ltd (PCIH) said on Tuesday DBS bank will procure subscriptions for 3.55 million new shares of Singapore $0.50 each in the company.
The procurement will be on a best endeavour basis at S$1.03 per placement share, PCIH said.
It said the subscription price of S$1.03 represented a premium of 7.3 percent over the last transacted price of S$0.96 per PCIH share on September 9.
The company said in a statement it planned to place out all of the new 3.55 million shares with one investor, Chong Lian Him.

"The net proceeds from the placement after deducting expenses pertaining to the placement is estimated at S$3.5 million. Of this amount, approximately S$1.2 million will be used to repay bank borrowings and the balance of the proceeds ammounting to S$2.4 million will be used for working capital," the statement said.
On completion of the transaction, the existing issued capital will increase by five percent from 70.93 million ordinary shares to 74.48 million shares.

PCIH said if the placement was effective on the date of the last audited sheet on September 30, the group net tangible assets per share, after adjusting the issue of placement shares, would have increased from S$0.43 to S$0.46.
